items.name: ForestTurkey
items.visual_note: Viewed six images: final runtime_r01/four_directions.png, runtime_visual_strip.png, existing playback_review_r01.png, and three new summaries composed from native GIF phases. The turkey has a round ochre-brown spotted belly, a pale gold long neck and wattle, and a five-feather rounded fan with gold bands and pale taupe tips. The front shows two eyes and a beak; the back shows only the back of the head and neck, with the centered tail fan covering much of the torso. Folded wings join both sides and two thin legs remain attached below the belly; no detached or duplicated limbs are visible. Up/Down native phase samples show alternating foot positions and a small body bob; turning samples retain the original side-view stride, and no ground shadow is visible in the inspected directions or action samples. Attack samples show angry front eyes followed by the normal face; hurt flashes white then recovers. The two death sequences show front/back sideward collapse, shrinking and progressive fade, followed by reuse with the normal front face and opaque body restored. Pause/speed samples retain the rear fan and connected legs. This was a six-summary-image visual review, not a new Play run or an exhaustive frame-by-frame review; pause/speed timing and same-instance reuse are separately supported by the existing two 84-check runtime reports. User art approval remains pending.

items.name: Ghost

Ghost has a white rounded sheet body, restrained beige side shading, ochre oval eyes and small mouth on the front, and a plain faceless rear. The final continuous upper-sheet/hem composite has no horizontal body gap; two short side flaps attach under the side outline, with no invented legs, bat wings or ground shadow. Floating poses show small changes in height and side flaps; turns switch between preserved original side art and the new front/rear, and front attack briefly shows slanted eyes and a fang mouth while the back stays faceless. The Up death sequence visibly flashes white, turns gray, tips sideways and fades progressively; reuse restores an opaque normal front and green health bar. Pause/speed samples retain the complete silhouette. Both real Play revisions passed 84 checks each, 680 recorded frames total. User art approval remains pending. Six image boards/views were actively inspected; no claim of continuous GIF playback.

Pause and speed samples retain the connected rear silhouette; timing and same-instance reuse are separately supported by the two actual Play reports, 84 PASS/0 FAIL each, 683 frames total. Left/Right retain the original compact golden spotted horse, cream swept forelock, pale noseband, ivory-gray saddle-pad border and long ochre tail; none of the four views shows a ground shadow. Up shows outer ears and an eyeless rear head, saddle on the back, rounded rump and a tail hanging from the rump; Down has a centered muzzle, two ears and a diagonal forelock obscuring one eye, with limb roots covered by the torso and no visibly detached appendages. Sampled Up/Down walk frames show alternating hoof positions and changing tail angles while the saddle stays attached; attack samples retain the front/rear structure. Up death samples show a full-body white flash, then a sideways fall and progressive transparency until almost invisible. Same-instance pool reuse and restored expression/alpha are confirmed separately by the two runtime assertion reports, not claimed as direct visual observation.

items.visual_note: 赭黄色毛茸茸圆腹与金色矩形鞍具保留，未见骑手或蘑菇簇。正面角头位于身体下缘，背面只露双角和后脑，腹背中线与鞍具连接完整，未见背面脸。短足从腹缘伸出，象牙色足尖清楚，上下步态样本呈小幅交替摆动，转向样本中身体与附肢保持连接。四向及攻击、受击、死亡和复用样本未见地面阴影，暂停与倍速样本中的鞍具、头和足也未见脱离。两轮死亡均先出现白闪，随后恢复色彩、倾斜收缩并逐渐变淡至消失，复用后正面、满血条和不透明度恢复。

items.name: Nightmare
items.visual_note: 已查看原角色参考、Up/Down 原图、离线拼装、最终 four_directions.png 和 runtime_visual_strip.png，共 6 张。最终左右侧面保留深橄榄色犬身、金色鬃毛、额部象牙独角和金色尾簇，正面脸部居中，背面是鬃毛、脊刺与斑点后躯，没有背面脸。离线初版腿根向外露出，已保留 offline_revision_r01 并将四足关节内收；最终正背面腿根由躯干遮挡，近侧宽爪落在身体两侧，远侧足被躯干部分遮住。行走汇总帧可见左右足的交替高低与细尾小幅偏转，四方向及攻击画面未见地面阴影。Up 死亡汇总帧先呈白色轮廓，随后恢复原色、侧倒并逐渐变淡至消失；复用另由两轮实际运行断言确认，本轮仅完成内部视觉检查，仍待用户美术审核。

items.name: Ogre
items.visual_note: 四方向实帧中，Ogre 保留橄榄褐色斑块、光头短发辫、粗壮躯干及右手带象牙刺的金色木棒，左右沿用原侧面轮廓，正面可见链项圈和骷髅腰扣。背面显示后脑、耳背、背部斑块与无骷髅的后腰带，双脚呈脚跟，没有背面脸或前向趾甲。上下行走采样中双腿交替抬足、身体轻微起伏，肩胯连接被躯干及腰布遮住，木棒随持械臂摆动。攻击采样可见抬臂挥棒，死亡采样先白闪再恢复原色，随后背向侧倒并渐淡，附肢与身体一同倾倒收拢。四向行走与背向死亡采样均未见地面阴影。

items.name: Ox
items.visual_note: Ox 保留金黄色斑点、奶油色宽口鼻、短弯角和深色分蹄，左右侧面与原设计一致。上下视图的四肢根部藏入躯干，背面头部没有五官，细尾从后躯中部垂下。行走采样中左右蹄呈交替抬落，身体和头部只有小幅摆动，攻击时正面眉眼转为愤怒。四向和运行采样均未见地面阴影，背向死亡依次出现白闪、侧倒和透明淡出。

items.name: Panther
items.visual_note: 已查看最终 four_directions.png 与 runtime_visual_strip.png。四向保留橄榄棕底色、黄褐斑点、尖耳和长弯尾，侧面为低伏长身，正背轴向轮廓明显较窄。背面头部没有五官，后爪为无前趾线的圆滑脚跟，尾巴从后躯向下弯；正面可见金眼、短口鼻、獠牙与爪趾。上下行走的取样连续帧可见足部交替、头身轻微摆动和尾部小幅偏摆，四向及死亡序列未见地面阴影。Up 死亡序列先整体白闪，再侧倒、收拢并逐渐淡出；同实例复用由程序断言确认，本次未另开复用 GIF。
